{{Quote|Assuming my translation is accurate, this ancient text from the planet Forntay relates how the primitive inhabitants rose up and defeated superior oppressors. Sadly, the natives are now extinct.|Emiel Skoff|<ref name="GG6-1" />}}
'''Emiel Skoff''' was an intellectual who sought out the means by which the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] could defeat the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].<ref name="GG6-1" />

==Biography==
Emiel taught at [[Darakin University]] and was well respected as an educator whose researches went above and beyond what was needed to teach his courses. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] assumed control of the curriculum, he left to continue his studies without Imperial intervention. He eventually made his way to the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] where he learned that the Empire had declared a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gesaril]] as being 'off-limits.' He believed that in such place information could be found that would help the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="GG6-1" />

==Personality and traits==
Tough-minded when it came to academics, Emiel was very naive about [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] as a whole and was content to immerse himself into his researches. He was always disheveled with scraps of paper tucked into every pocket and rarely taking the time to groom himself properly.<ref name="GG6-1" />
